records.title: Joint Japan/World Bank Graduate Scholarship Program (JJ/WBGSP) 2027 - Application Window #1 (Developing Country Nationals)

validation.notes: Verified by fetching the SVG directly: it is a 220x44 vector containing the World Bank grid-globe logomark plus the 'WORLD BANK' wordmark set in #002F54, i.e. the institution's real brand mark rather than an icon or UI glyph. Hosted on the official provider domain www.worldbank.org and declared by the site's own header component with alt="World Bank Logo" / title="World Bank Logo". MEDIUM rather than HIGH for two honest reasons: (1) the World Bank publishes no separate JJ/WBGSP programme logotype, so this is the official logo of the awarding institution named in official_source ('World Bank, Development Economics Vice Presidency'), not a programme-specific mark; (2) it is the global top-nav variant served by the header service rather than a file published on a dedicated brand/asset page (www.worldbank.org/en/about/brand returns 404). An alternate lockup '/content/dam/wbr/logo/logo-wb-header-en.svg' (logo plus the 'Working for a World Free of Poverty' tagline) was seen only in search-engine rendering and was not fetched, so it is not asserted here.

records.title: AFdoc – Aides à la formation doctorale (FNR PhD funding scheme)

validation.notes: Found on FNR's own dedicated brand page 'FNR Logo & Communication Guidelines' at https://www.fnr.lu/logo/, which is the top item of that page and is linked from the site-wide footer. I downloaded the PNG and viewed it: it is the official horizontal lockup - the FNR monogram plus the 'Luxembourg National Research Fund' wordmark - with a clean white background and no screenshot framing. The AFdoc programme page itself carries no AFdoc-specific logotype (its only imagery is a 1181x710 news/hero illustration, and the site's icons are LinkedIn avatar crops), so the funding agency's official logo is the correct identity mark for this record, whose official_source is 'Fonds National de la Recherche (FNR), Luxembourg'. The alternate colourway FNR_LOGO_Black.png is published alongside it on the same page but was not needed.

validation.notes: Same official asset and same reasoning as scholarship_id 475. I fetched https://www.worldbank.org/en/programs/scholarships/japanese-nationals and it carries no JJ/WBGSP programme logotype - only photography and PDF links - so the World Bank institutional logo, served by the official domain's own header component as alt="World Bank Logo", is the correct official brand mark. validation.notes: Exact identity match. The shard's official_source is 'Ministry of Public Service, Government Efficiency and Implementation, Government of Guyana', and I downloaded this PNG and viewed it: the Guyana coat of arms beside the words 'Ministry of Public Service, Government Efficiency & Implementation'. It is the site's own site-logo (class="site-logo-image") on the official Government of Guyana Scholarships page at mps.gov.gy, an official .gov.gy government domain, which is the record's own catalogue_url. The official portal page https://portal.gov.gy/services/scholarship independently confirms this body is the administrator: 'The Ministry of Public Service, Government Efficiency and Implementation advertises and administers Government of Guyana scholarships.' Rejected nearby: the coat-of-arms file used only as favicon/apple-touch-icon, the 1080x1080 MPS-Scholarship illustrations, and the Government of Guyana Portal brand mark (a different brand from the named ministry). The portal's footer also carries a National Disaster Management Agency (NDMA) logo on the shared portal CDN - an unrelated agency, rejected on that basis - but I did not re-verify its hashed Next.js build filename, so no URL is asserted for it.
